verdict.rationale: Discord's own developer platform documents building "automated apps, commands, and integrations that run inside Discord servers." Bots authenticate with bot tokens and receive server events over the Gateway WebSocket, so background automations are possible. However, users must write and host their own bot code (or install third-party apps from the App Directory), and the evidence shows no native, user-configurable automation feature. Missing for 10: native no-code automation or scheduling for end users, documentation of background or scheduled execution, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
